column1: # GiuliaGate campaign -- prior configuration, decided by the author on 2026-10-31.
# Read by apply_prior_patch.py: it patches the boxes of the free axes into this folder's copy of
# HPC_main_sweep.py and gives the launchers the freeze list (the fixed axes, NAME=VALUE).
# Edit only status (free|fixed), low and high (free rows) and value (fixed rows); then run
# APPLY_GG.txt steps 0 and 4 again. Natural units (unit column). scale is computed, not set: log
# when low > 0 and high/low >= 10 (the rule of HPC_main_sweep.py), else lin. Rows of the group
# neuron_frozen, and I_Theta and omega_I, are outside the sweep group: their value must equal the
# registry. The two topology rows are read by the launchers (conn_prob and gate boxes).
# registry: the 37-D default (root pipeline). giulia_copy: Giulia campaigns v1-v5 (repository copy

column11: width of the per-neuron bias current: each neuron gets I_inj*u, u ~ U[-0.5, 0.5] fixed per network
asynchronous release: per-spike increment of the release rate toward U_max
asynchronous release: ceiling of the per-vesicle release rate
asynchronous release: decay rate of the release rate
recovery rate of the vesicle pool (depression)
effect of gliotransmission on release probability
quantal vesicle size (fraction of the pool per release)
presynaptic receptor binding rate of gliotransmitter
permeability of the astrocyte IP3 flux through gap junctions and from the exogenous source
astrocyte Ca2+ threshold for gliotransmitter exocytosis (and for an astrocyte event)
astrocyte mGluR glutamate binding rate (neuron-to-astrocyte coupling)
flat rule: each directed neuron pair wired with this probability, one draw per network
contact gate: each viable contact (a synapse and its nearest astrocyte within stoa_cutoff) kept with this probability, one draw per network; uptake and gliotransmission gated together
